reason: Adds image-path handling and an analyze_image tool so models without native vision support can obtain descriptions through a configured external vision API, while preserving native image handling for vision-capable models.

summaries.zh: 该插件将聊天图片映射为本地附件路径，并通过配置的视觉 API 为不支持图像输入的模型提供识图工具。
summaries.en: This plugin maps chat images to local attachment paths and provides a vision tool backed by a configured API for models without native image support.

capabilities: Reads image attachments from dsh-managed local paths
Sends selected images to a configured OpenAI-compatible vision API
Provides an analyze_image tool to eligible models
Uses configured model, endpoint, token limit, and credential reference settings
